title: How to Make Whatever You Want and Still Get Attention
prompt: Build a hyper-local narrative game builder toy inspired by Stanley Baxton's BAFTA Breakthrough story. The player picks a very specific real-world location (a bus stop, a laundrette, a chip shop) and three hyper-local character archetypes; the app generates a tiny two-screen interactive story vignette from those inputs. A 'specificity score' rewards unusual, niche combinations over generic settings. Hand-drawn zine aesthetic with limited risograph color palette.
